sections.changelog:
Added

  • Opening hours: a "Same time for every day" control that applies one time range to all seven days at once.

Changed

  • Homepage scanner now shows the full discovered data (name, phone, email and the actual address) instead of a generic "address" label.
  • Neutralized all placeholder and hint examples (city, region, street, phone, description, business type, messenger handles) so they no longer reference a specific city or trade.

Fixed

  • Checkboxes and radio buttons sat above their label (boilerplate top-alignment); they are now vertically centered across the plugin.
